note: Oracle for forge's strengthening probes (§7 step 5, issue #14). ADVISORY (R-CHAR-3): probes never change the verdict; they surface adoptable stronger-ens SUGGESTIONS. A suggestion must (a) VERIFY against the real body and (b) be strictly stronger (kill a #12 survivor). The suggestions list is oracle-EXCLUDED from the deterministic cert subset (it is advisory); the checkable property is: a weak contract yields a verifying+stronger suggestion; a tight contract yields none. Suggestions are hand-derived (the obvious tight contract for the body), not echoed from forge.

has_suggestion.name: weak_loose_bound
has_suggestion.program: fn f(a: u32, b: u32) -> u32 req a <= 10 && b <= 10 ens result <= 1000000 fx pure { a + b }
has_suggestion.why: The weak `ens result <= 1000000` lets the early-return-0 mutant survive. The candidate `ens result == a + b` VERIFIES against the real body `{ a + b }` and KILLS the survivor (0 == a+b unprovable) -> a strictly-stronger, adoptable suggestion the probe must surface.

no_suggestion.name: corpus_sum
no_suggestion.why: sum's `ens result == spec_sum(xs)` already pins the output exactly; no candidate is strictly stronger (its golden survivor is invariant-killed, not ens-killed) -> no strengthening suggestion.
